title: Floating Mystics in Cosmic Disk
description: A massive ornate golden disc with swirling purple and orange patterns hovers in a starry night sky above a surreal seascape. Four robed figures sit in meditation on a smaller glowing platform beneath the disc, while small rocky islands with glowing trees and swirling mist float on dark teal waters below.
